summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of iteration-18 substitution features: (1) bulk teacher activate/deactivate/delete via new toolbar, (2) late-added absent tracking (late_ids + absent[].late flag), (3) stats subs_p8 column + teacher_absence_rows, (4) day export ?absent_id= addendum filter, (5) swap CRUD (POST/GET/DELETE/clear + candidates + docx export), (6) SubPrint page PDF/image/Word/browser-print buttons, (7) late-absent addendum print via ?late= query. Backend: 6/6 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_substitution_swap_bulk_late.py (iter18_swap.xml). Frontend Playwright: login OK; teachers page bulk toolbar tested — select-all checked 49 rows, deselect cleared, bulk-deactivate produced 2 غير نشط badges, bulk-activate cleared them back to 0; stats page table now shows ح٨ column (headers ['م','المعلم','المادة','النصاب','الغياب','الاحتياط','ح٨','التوزيع']); swap page full flow succeeded end-to-end — teacher A selected, period A picked, 25 candidates returned, candidate B picked, period B picked, تأكيد التبادل created a swap that appeared in the swap-report table (1 row); SubPrint page shows all four buttons in order (طباعة/حفظ PDF, تحميل PDF, تحميل كصورة, Word); late-absent warning icon renders on chip; opening /substitution/print/{date}?late={absent_id} renders the ملحق addendum note. Everything works.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/substitution.py is now 1121 lines (grew from 917 in iter-17, previously flagged >700 cap). Strongly recommend splitting into modules (auth, teachers, day, stats, swap, export, supervision, settings) — the new swap section (lines 965-1122) is a natural boundary.
SubTeachers.jsx WeekModal uses <> fragments inside a map without keys on the fragment; keys are on inner children which works in React 18 but produces a subtle warning surface. Minor.
SubSwap.jsx `word()` fetch does not check response.ok; a 4xx would silently download an error blob. Minor — same pattern as elsewhere in codebase, not a regression.

In DistributeParts.jsx the 'معلم متأخر — تحميل ملحق PDF' badge only renders on the group-header row when the late teacher already has at least one assignment. If a user marks a teacher late but never assigns a substitute, the addendum link never appears — this is a reasonable design but worth documenting (the warning icon on the chip is the only affordance in that state).

Late-flag semantics: `late_ids &= set(ids)` on set_absent means removing a late teacher and re-adding them AFTER distribution correctly re-flags them; however if the last existing substitute assignment is cleared (day becomes 'undistributed'), previously late teachers keep their late flag — because was_distributed only gates the addition path. Not a bug per se but a subtle stateful behavior worth a unit test.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iter-18 flows verified: bulk toolbar, stats ح٨ col, swap end-to-end, print buttons, late addendum ?late=)

Backend enforces: cannot swap self, both teachers must have periods, if period_a != period_b both must be mutually free at the other's period. late_ids is tracked in day doc; enrich_day() surfaces it as absent[i].late.
